mcp.note: rustre-il is a source-only foundational crate (IlTier enum, IlError enum); the MCP server analyzes binaries, not crate sources, so no MCP tool mirrors this validator. Source inspection of crates/rustre-il/src/lib.rs confirms all 3 IlError variants (Unsupported, TierMismatch, Invalid) are present with correct #[error(...)] messages and thiserror derive.

analysis.root_cause: Validator regex 'pub\s+enum\s+IlError\s*\{([^}]*)\}' is terminated prematurely by the '}' inside #[error("... {op} ... {tier:?} ...")] attribute interpolation tokens, so the captured enum body is truncated before the variant names. The Rust source is correct; the validator has a parser bug.
analysis.evidence: crates/rustre-il/src/lib.rs lines 57-65 define IlError with all three variants and proper #[error] attributes; cargo build succeeds; downstream crates compile against these variants.
